tldr: Global Microsoft services, including Teams and Outlook, experienced an outage that stretched into a second day, impacting users worldwide.
The 10-year Treasury yield rose as October's producer price index data indicated higher wholesale prices, fueling expectations of a potential Federal Reserve rate hike.
Nvidia's CEO, Jensen Huang, resigned amid a scandal, leading to concerns about the company's AI dominance and future leadership.

market.why: The stock market indices closed lower, with the Nasdaq Composite notably down, influenced by the latest producer price index report indicating rising wholesale prices. This was compounded by significant news in the tech sector, including a global Microsoft outage affecting key services and the resignation of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang amidst a scandal, raising questions about the company's future in AI.

yield_10y.why: The 10-year Treasury yield increased to 5.1%, driven by higher-than-expected producer price index data for October and strengthening investor expectations for a potential Federal Reserve rate hike in December as the central bank addresses inflation.

vix.why: The VIX increased, indicating a rise in market volatility, likely in response to the latest inflation data and its implications for Federal Reserve policy, as well as the significant news from the tech sector regarding Microsoft's global outage and Nvidia's CEO resignation.

Mid-range - 40% of the way up its 1-month band.

mortgage.why: The 30-year fixed mortgage rate, as reported in a weekly survey released on 2026-11-12, decreased slightly to 7.11%. This movement typically tracks the direction of the 10-year Treasury yield over recent days, rather than a single day's movement, with the 10-year yield having risen on 2026-11-12.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: Temporary regulations were issued concerning a new nonrefundable Federal tax credit for qualified contributions to scholarship granting organizations.
policy_upcoming.effect: A new nonrefundable Federal tax credit becomes available for qualified contributions to scholarship granting organizations in 2027 and later taxable years.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: Final rules set forth requirements for price transparency reporting for non-grandfathered group health plans and health insurance issuers.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your employer health insurance plan has new price transparency reporting requirements that become effective on December 7, 2026.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

policy_calendar.label: FHFA conforming loan limit for next year — expected late November
policy_calendar.note: The cap on a conforming (non-jumbo) mortgage, and the line between a normal rate and a jumbo one. FHFA has announced it in the last days of November each year, and the new limit applies to loans made from January 1.

tech.summary: OpenAI has launched ChatGPT Wallet, allowing its 'dots' AI agents to make purchases for users through partnerships with American Express, Mastercard, and Visa, enabling cardholders to retain existing credit card rewards.
Microsoft is experiencing a global outage affecting services including Teams and Outlook, which the company has attributed to failed server health checks rather than malicious cyber-activity.

SpaceX's Starship is preparing for a historic test flight, as the company works to develop its new massive rocket which could eventually replace NASA's primary transport to the International Space Station.

world.summary: Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps claims to have targeted and destroyed a US early-warning radar in Bahrain, stating it was in retaliation for a US airstrike on a communications tower in Sirik.

Europe's foreign policy chief, Kaja Kallas, issued a warning to EU leaders against 'walking into the traps that Russia is setting' in proposed Ukraine peace talks, cautioning against Moscow's sequencing of events.
India's capital, New Delhi, has surpassed Pakistan's Lahore to become the world's most polluted city, according to recent reports.

us.summary: An investigation is currently underway in Brooklyn, New York, following an apartment building collapse into a nearby construction site that resulted in the deaths of at least eight people.
Cindy Holscher won the Kansas gubernatorial race, securing the governor's office for the Democrats in a state that has largely favored the Republican party in other statewide elections.

The Trump administration has begun hiring debt collectors for the first time in six years to pursue defaulted student-loan borrowers, with the Treasury Department proposing to pay these collectors less than in the past.

science.summary: A study involving nearly 10,000 people found that the antidepressant escitalopram was most effective at preventing depression symptoms from returning, though the differences in effectiveness among various medications were generally small.

A regulator's report indicates that trainee doctors involved in delivering babies are more likely to experience overwork and burnout compared to other medical specialties, potentially posing risks to maternity patients.
